customer_question: Our quarterly security review says we must rotate the API token used by our internal reporting script. What's the correct way to do it?
resolution: Gave the procedure documented at the time: first revoke the old token under Settings → API tokens, then create a new token and update the script with it. Warned that API calls fail with CF-401 between revoking the old token and deploying the new one, so the change should be made in a quiet period. The customer completed the rotation; the script had about 10 minutes of CF-401 errors during the switch.
